title: Missing Evidence Planted Defects Regression Gate

coverageModel.deterministicFailureProof: The selftest command loads every planted defect JSON file, applies it to the current repository evidence state, and fails unless the expected rule id appears in the validator findings.
coverageModel.failureOutputBoundary: The validator reports severity, rule id, subject, and safe failure message. It does not expose secrets, real tenant data, raw provider payloads, tokens, stack traces, or live endpoints.

regressionCategories.ruleRange: USF-TEST-READINESS-029 through USF-TEST-READINESS-039 and USF-TEST-READINESS-076 through USF-TEST-READINESS-080
regressionCategories.prevents: Missing or stale semantic obligation manifest rows, dependency graph entries, generated Compose coverage, validator wiring, schema registry linkage, or expanded category obligations.

regressionCategories.ruleRange: USF-TEST-READINESS-022 through USF-TEST-READINESS-028 and USF-TEST-READINESS-095 through USF-TEST-READINESS-101
regressionCategories.prevents: Missing command surface, stale package or Make wiring, missing LCOV, stale Sonar import, downgraded coverage threshold, or unapproved exclusion.
